newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB shares soar ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: NAB shares soar ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Australia's largest bank, National Australia Bank (NAB), jumped sharply on Monday after suspension of its share buyback scheme sparked speculation of strong half year profit result.
By 12.05 p.m. (0205 GMT), NAB shares were over 1.6 percent higher at A$16.78 after touching an intraday high of A$16.90.
NAB's half year results are due on May 15.

While the buyback's suspension by itself was seen having minimal impact, if a strong result was expected then the bank would not wish to be seen disadvantaging shareholders who accepted the buyback offer just prior to the result's release.
"Some people reckon there may be good things to come," said a dealer at a Sydney-based brokerage.
"But the bank doesn't want to be seen to be front running shareholders in the buyback scheme ahead of the results."
By 1.15 p.m. (0315 GMT), NAB shares were 28 cents higher at A$16.79 on turnover of 2.7 million shares.
